generality_contract.seed_selection: all outcome-blind natural maximum-count rows with N >= 7
generality_contract.primary_metric: log(patched donor / patched receiver-original) - log(blank donor / blank receiver-original)
generality_contract.strong_endpoint: new adoption requires blank output not equal donor and patched output equal donor
generality_contract.interpretation: positive relative log-odds without new adoption is graded causal ordinal information only
